If \(m\) is odd, then \(f(x)=x-m=t\).

Thus integral over this interval is \(-\int_0^1t\cos\pi t\,dt=\frac{2}{\pi^2}\).

So each interval of length \(1\) gives the same integral value \(\frac{2}{\pi^2}\).

From \(-10\) to \(10\), there are \(20\) such intervals.
